rib_lock_tally_gate.line_1: The sensing cord touches my wrist through the glove and twitches with my pulse. The toll mouth opens just wide enough for biomass or a shoulder.
rib_lock_tally_gate.line_2: The cord counts while the mouth waits. The shoulder gap is narrow, and the rib is already flexing toward shut.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: quiet pass. Echo: pulse timing retained by transit tissue.

One rib opens without tearing. The wet tally cut pulses once at the same interval as my wrist.

lines: I press biomass into the valve until the inner teeth stop closing.
The counting cord tightens twice. The fresh tally cut closes clean after the seam opens.

push_through_spikes.preview: Immediate: flesh cost. Echo: broken rib vibration retained.
lines: I put my shoulder into the rib before the counting cord finishes.
The seam opens unevenly. The broken edge leaves red fiber and shell dust on my sleeve.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The cord keeps my pulse after the seam opens. Its last twitch matches my wrist.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The biomass does not stay local. A receipt blister swells shut behind the wall.

I step off before it commits. The lock resets next time.

event.line_1: The sensing cord arrives already patient. It expects my long gap.
event.line_2: If I break it now, that patience will not return soon.

lines: I ride the patient beat. The seam answers soft.
I break the habit. The cord hardens back to standard counts.

rib_lock_larval_cradle.line_2: Larger ferries wait lower in the black fluid. Their tendon straps are wider, and the old harness cuts are already opening.

It carries me through slowly. The loops hold, and the far seam opens without a splash.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: fast damaged passage. Echo: torn harness load retained.
lines: I drop onto the large ferries before their straps finish taking my weight.
They cross fast. Two tendon loops tear loose and stay hooked in my boot.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: signal muted. Echo: missing command phrase retained.
lines: I twist the wet baffle until the bell polyps stop vibrating through the fluid.
Chorus drops to static for three beats. The far seam opens on the fourth.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The protected ferry-larva sinks with my weight still intact in its harness.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The torn harness keeps my load mark. The tendon fibers do not relax.

turn_baffle.queued_line: The muted bell polyps close on the middle of Chorus' signal.

event.line_1: Service larva lifts its head fast at the sight of my clean rim.
event.line_2: Ride now and it reads me deep; refuse and I keep the trail cooler.

lines: I lower into the harness. It carries me slow and memorizes the edge.
Later wet locks will angle to it.
I wave it off. The head sinks.
No added trail.

rib_lock_clot_bypass.line_2: The lower gap is wet with shellac. Clean ridges are setting above it, and the outside face still takes blood.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: damaged shortcut. Echo: repair motion retained.

The repair scrapes open across my back and leaves hot shellac in the cut.

lines: I leave the shortcut alone and let the beetles finish sealing the breach.
The finished repair leaves three clean ridges across the seam, straight enough to follow.

The beetles turn to that blood mark first and seal it into the wrong side of the shellac.

white_marrow_field.line_2: One lane matches my stride too neatly. Loose marrow shows under the cleanest cuts.

follow_marked_plates.preview: Immediate: safer marked lane. Echo: stride spacing retained.
lines: I follow the clean lane and keep my feet inside the old cuts.
The lice turn after me in a single line. Their clean edges keep the spacing of my stride.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: messier lane. Echo: dirty survey edge retained.
lines: I step across two cuts and drag my heel through the lice line.
The insects scatter and leave the lane dirty. No clean edge holds the shape of my stride.

scavenge_bones.preview: Immediate: biomass gain. Echo: warm absence retained.
lines: I pry ration marrow from the cleaned bone before the lice close over it.
The exposed cut goes cold around my hand. Lice gather at the warm absence.

white_marrow_field.line_1: A leukocyte hound works the survey-cut lane ahead of me: nose down, stepping exactly where the lice have stripped the bone clean and left pale edges where my boots want to land.
white_marrow_field.line_2: The hound is not fast yet. It is waiting for my stride to confirm the field's prediction. If I step where the cuts say to, its jaws will be in position before I clear the lane.

follow_marked_plates.preview: Immediate: learn safer foot placement. Echo: future marrow lanes may offer cold-step movement.
lines: I put weight on the cold cut instead of the warm flat where my foot wants to fall.
The hound checks the wrong place. My next step lands before its jaws commit. The lane has a trick I can repeat.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: spoil pursuit lane. Echo: later survey cuts may be less reliable.
lines: I rake loose marrow across the clean cuts and stamp once where the lice are thickest.
The hound noses three possible trails and loses the clean one. The field is messier behind me, and less useful ahead.

combat.preview: Immediate: stop running and take a wound. Echo: leukocyte pursuit remembers blood.
lines: I stop before the lane can choose for me. The hound hits low and opens my forearm against the white floor.
I drive my knee into its throat ridge and shove it across the cuts. The lice leave my bootprints and gather on the blood instead.

follow_marked_plates.queued_line: The cold edge keeps its shape in my foot after I leave the field.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: Marrow dust stays in the cuts behind me. The clean lane does not close clean.

combat.queued_line: The hound blood cools fast on the marrow. Other noses will find that.

seal_amber_wound.preview: Immediate: protective seal. Echo: sampled wound edge retained.

The seal holds. It also leaves a clean operator-shaped edge in my skin.

leave_mutation.preview: Immediate: procedure refused. Echo: closed pores retained.

The amoebae dim in sequence. Nothing samples me, and nothing answers.

operator_cellar.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar.line_1: A predator has threaded its limbs into the wall-control holes and is running the old operator grip-sequence. When my boot crosses the threshold it stops and locks onto me: body flush to the wall, low, already angled for a strike.
operator_cellar.line_2: The ceiling is close enough to cut off any upward move. Three limbs are anchored in the holes; the fourth hangs free and cocked toward my face. That free limb is the strike. If I wait, it commits. If I go now, I beat it to the anchor.

buttons.label: Read its limb structure before committing
Break its grip rhythm before it can set
Drive straight through before it can anchor deeper
Take the strike and hold your ground
Pull back and give it the room

probe_bones.preview: Hymn delays commitment to study the predator's anchor points and load-bearing limbs, gaining tactical information at the cost of giving the predator time to act.
lines: I hold my position and watch where its weight is. Three limbs are load-bearing inside the wall holes. The fourth is free and cocked toward my face. That is the strike limb.

It launches the free limb. I am already moving off the line. The strike hits wall tissue instead of me. Its grip pattern is exposed: it cannot reload that limb without releasing one anchor. I know where to go next.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Hymn disrupts the predator's established grip sequence, collapsing its tempo and forcing a recovery pause that opens a window for follow-through.
lines: I move toward the wall and knock the nearest anchor limb out of its hole before the sequence can complete. The predator's body shudders. It was braced for me to wait, not close.

It scrambles to reset its grip. For two full seconds it is not a predator, it is just a body trying to find purchase on a wall it no longer controls. I use those seconds. It releases the wall and drops. The room is mine.

push_through_spikes.preview: Hymn commits to forward pressure, accepting contact damage to deny the predator time to fully brace, forcing it off the wall through sheer displacement.
lines: I go forward instead of back. Its free limb catches my shoulder on the way in. The grip is strong but I am already past the angle where it can use the wall for leverage.

Without the wall it is lighter than I expected. I push it off its anchor and it hits the far side of the cellar. It does not come back. My shoulder is marked where it held. The mark is deep but the room is clear.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Hymn absorbs the predator's committed strike to bait it into a full extension, then exploits the recovery gap while it reloads.
lines: I let it hit me. The free limb lands across my forearm and the grip is immediate, tight, and pulling. I do not move back. It has committed everything to that grip and now it cannot release without losing its wall anchor too.

It holds for three seconds before the wall tissue starts to pull away from its anchor limbs. It chose the grip over the anchor. That was the wrong choice. It drops. My forearm is split along the contact line but the split is already closing. I have been in worse rooms.

retreat.preview: Hymn exits before the predator can close, ceding the cellar but avoiding contact cost. The predator remains active as a future hazard.
lines: I back through the doorway before it can commit. It does not follow past the threshold. It returns to the wall holes and resumes the grip sequence like I was never here.
The cellar is still running the lure. I will have to come back through it or find another route. The predator knows I read it. Next time it will not wait as long before striking.

operator_cellar.line_2: The ceiling keeps my arms below shoulder height. The doorway is narrowing my angle behind me. The wall is the only leverage it has; if I break that leverage before it fires, the fight changes.

probe_bones.preview: Baseline discipline route. Hymn spends a breath reading the anchor geometry, identifies the counter-window after the committed pull, and enters on her terms. Costs time, raises baseline_discipline, records route_memory of tool-hole spacing.
lines: Its limbs are threaded deep but the angle is wrong for a sustained pull. It has to commit fully to move me, and the moment after that commitment is open.
I wait for it. It pulls. I step inside the pull and the wall takes the force instead of me. The grip breaks at the third hole from the left. I remember that.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Aggressive baseline route. Hymn disrupts the predator's anchor sequence before it finishes locking, forcing it into an unbraced exchange. Costs wound_debt on contact, raises hunt_pressure as the disruption is loud.
lines: I move before it finishes the sequence. It is not fully anchored and the disruption pulls two of its limbs free. The third holds and it swings with that.
The contact is hard and low. I take it on the side and push through. It loses the wall. The fight is short after that but I am bleeding.

push_through_spikes.preview: High-commitment baseline route. Hymn closes distance immediately, accepting contact to deny the predator its leverage advantage. Speed or cut mutation tags open a cleaner version of this branch. Wound debt is likely.
lines: I close before it can finish setting. The ceiling keeps me low and that is actually right for this. I hit it at the wall and the anchor does not hold against direct pressure from inside its own angle.
It tears free. Some of that is mine. The room is quiet after.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Wound-debt route with brace or barrier symbiote tag. Baseline Hymn absorbs the pull and holds position, raising baseline_discipline but incurring significant wound_debt. Barrier symbiote absorbs the force at cost to symbiote health.
lines: It pulls. I do not move. The force is real and it costs me but the wall gets nothing from this exchange and neither does the predator.
It releases when it cannot shift me. I am still standing. The damage is mine to carry but the ground is mine too.

lines: I keep the sacs closed and move with the seam’s rhythm.
The seam stiffens one notch. I hear a dry tick travel the wall.

siphon_amber.queued_line: The sugar smell keeps to my glove. The wall holds it.

seal_amber_wound.queued_line: The thin film cools and keeps a faint tack when I flex my hand.

leave_amber.queued_line: That dry tick keeps moving along the seam.

siphon_amber.queued_line: The sweetness does not fade. It sits in the seam like a kept breath.

amber_corridor.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor.line_1: A flat amber plaque slides open. Bead organs pulse inside it like a wet abacus. Each pulse clicks the resin once against bone.
amber_corridor.line_2: Feeding biomass dulls the clicks and keeps this lane quiet. Refusing or walking past lets it finish a count with my heat in it.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: quiet clicks stored as clean count.
lines: I press biomass into the valve until the inner teeth stop closing.
The beads stop at a flat line. The plaque seals with one dry click.

skip_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: no payment. Echo: open count kept with a risk tick.
lines: I close my hand and let the plaque count me anyway.
The beads finish their line. Two soft clicks persist after it shuts.

leave_amber.preview: Immediate: pass without contact. Echo: partial count noise and lost quiet.
lines: I step past before the last bead settles.
The plaque coughs and holds a partial. One click hangs in the wall like a small cough.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: A flat line holds under the resin lid.

skip_resin_toll.queued_line: Two soft clicks keep time in the wall.

leave_amber.queued_line: That small cough does not leave the seam.

Leave the plaque: Hymn leaves sealed resource untouched and keeps the wound quiet.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Rows of red bone spikes rise and fall on a fixed interval. The floor set is closing one notch sooner than the wall set, which leaves a shoulder-width lane that narrows as I watch.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: Forcing a gap will scrape me. Breaking tips costs less now and leaves grit. Waiting for the open beat keeps my skin but risks the click ahead shifting position.

buttons.label: Time the open beat and proceed

push_through_spikes.preview: Immediate: wound and noise. Echo: lane vibration retained.
lines: I shoulder the narrowing lane before the next rise.
Spines scrape my arm and sing against each other. The row keeps a small tremor after I pass.

break_spike_lane.preview: Immediate: lesser wound, small biomass. Echo: grit residue retained.
lines: I snap three soft tips in a line and kick the grit forward.
The lane widens a hand. Red grit sticks to my boot tread.

proceed.preview: Immediate: clean pass if timed. Echo: interval retained.
lines: I count two closes and step on the third open.
The lane holds just long enough. My pace keeps the interval in my legs.

follow_up_specs.queued_line_hint: The tips I moved past still tick against each other.
Grit holds in my tread; the next floor will show it.
My legs keep the count after the lane closes.

possibility_tree: Push through the spikes: Hymn forces passage and makes injury part of the route record.
Break a path: Hymn damages the obstacle and leaves a louder, altered path behind.
Time the open beat and proceed: Hymn carries the visible pressure forward without resolving it.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: A Spine Stalker rides the lane as a cleaner. Its back spines lie flat and sweep grit in a measured pass.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: My boot scrapes broken tips. The row rises and pinches for my shin. If I move now I pass on the counted open; if I hold, the teeth close; if I shove, I pay in sleeve; if I rattle the tips, it may drop the sweep without a catch.

Back out and lose this lane
Rattle the tips and warn it off

combat.preview: Immediate: stalker down or wounded pass. Echo: blood scent in red lanes.
lines: I square my shoulders inside the row and cut while the tips rise.
The stalker’s back spines catch my sleeve. Its click returns once as it folds.

run.preview: Immediate: risky slip. Echo: interval use retained.
lines: I move on the counted open before it finishes aligning.
Its grasp closes on air. The row behind me clicks once, off-time.

retreat.preview: Immediate: lose access. Echo: sealing increases ahead.
lines: I back out over my own scrapes.
The lane tightens fully. The next corridor will close faster for me.

break_spike_lane.preview: Immediate: non-lethal warning. Echo: grit trace and cooled pursuit window possible.
lines: I snap two forward tips and rake grit toward its eyes without stepping in.
The stalker flattens lower and shifts back into the rows. The lane keeps the broken line.

follow_up_specs.queued_line_hint: Blood warms the air behind me.
A rear row clicks out of time once.
Fresh hardening ridges pull the next lane shut sooner.
Chipped tips and grit mark the lane I rattled.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Hymn
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Visual on the chamber core. A heart the size of a furnace hangs from black cords; the keeper is planted beneath the vent with a hook-graft ready.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: Fighting breaks the guard and opens the chamber fully. Skirting the beat avoids engagement but leaves the keeper intact and the room unresolved.

combat.echo_notes: red_plate_spill and harsher beat residues will affect later red rooms.
lines: I go in on the off-beat and commit before the vent exhales.
Plates crack. The hook skids across the floor. The far seam opens and stays open long enough to cross.

proceed.preview: Immediate: timed slip on the open beat.
proceed.echo_notes: The route records red_pulse_interval_recorded and leaves red_guard_unresolved for attention pressure.
lines: I keep to the wall and move only when the vent throws heat.
I cross during the longest exhale and leave the keeper behind the cords. The vent ring clicks once after I pass and keeps the count.

possibility_tree: Cut down the heart keeper: Hymn answers as a fighter; wounds, noise, and rival recognition can follow.
Avoid the keeper: Hymn carries the visible pressure forward without resolving it.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Hymn
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The pulse throws heat against my chest at regular intervals. Old splash arcs on the wall match a missed off-beat at shoulder height.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: The vent ring ticks after each exhale. If I act on the wrong count, the keeper’s hook reaches me before the seam lifts.

buttons.label: Hold my breath to the ring and move on the long gap
Score one cord to drag the next beat low
Back off fast while the count is wrong

observe_organ_chamber.echo_notes: Enables one on-beat opening in a later red corridor.
lines: I count four full beats and sync the fifth with my breath.
The far seam answers on the same rhythm and lifts a finger-width longer. The vent ring taps once after I pass.

cut_heart_cords.preview: Immediate: brief vent sag; risk of room strain.
cut_heart_cords.echo_notes: Later red rooms thicken the beat cadence.
lines: I notch one black cord and let it slip three fibers before I back off.
The next beat drops low and carries more heat across the floor. The cord’s polish shows fresh scrape where I cut.

retreat.echo_notes: Schedules a short pursuit tied to breath noise.
lines: I pull back on the wrong count and brush a plate stack. It clatters once and keeps ringing in the vent.
I lose the long exhale window in this direction and leave a noise trail the hunt can read.

retreat.queued_line: The chamber noise does not die when I clear it. A thin ring keeps time with my uneven breath.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Hymn
organ_chamber_red.line_1: I fix on the pulse vent as the chamber settles. Its counting ring ticks once and then holds a longer gap while warm air leaks past the lip.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: If I finish a full set against the ring, the red pays attention. If I leave on this gap, I keep the read I already have.

buttons.label: Hold still at the vent and finish a full count
Move on before the next surge

observe_organ_chamber.echo_notes: Refresh or confirm interval for next red room.
lines: I keep my breath shallow and track the ring on the vent face: four steady taps, then a longer gap.
The seam noise fades when I match the longer gap with my lungs.

proceed.preview: Immediate: no extra read.
lines: I leave before the next long exhale. The ring keeps ticking behind me.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: The split wraps a green support spine. Left is soft and warm. Right is dry shell over cartilage with scrape channels. The airway wheel hums in the wall. Spores hang low and lift when the floor flexes.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Soft tissue accepts my weight and mends shallow cuts while it learns me. Cutting the green spine yields biomass and makes the corridor louder. Waiting lets the spores settle and the wheel report its breath.

buttons.label: Back away and take another route

take_green_tunnel.preview: Immediate: soft contact and slight mend. Echo: warmth print retained by corridor tissue.
lines: I put my weight into the soft lane and keep my knees bent.
The floor mends a shallow scrape along my calf and keeps its heat where my feet pass.

cut_green_spine.preview: Immediate: biomass yield and corridor noise. Echo: bright scrape continuity retained.
lines: I open the green spine with two shallow cuts and take a strip of wet tissue.
The dry shell resonates along the right branch. Scrape channels brighten in a straight line.

listen_at_green_split.preview: Immediate: spores settle and wheel tone maps breaths. Echo: muted-lane interest retained if repeated elsewhere.
lines: I hold still while the spores drop to ankle height again.
The airway wheel clicks three times and falls quiet. My next step sets the tone off-beat.

retreat.preview: Immediate: small noise carried forward. Echo: corridor keeps a faint alarm line.
lines: I back out slow. The dry shell still carries the scrape I made turning around.
A light tick runs along the right branch after I leave.

possibility_tree: Enter the soft branch: Hymn chooses the altered route and lets it shape future traversal.
Cut the green spine: Hymn wounds the alternate route to make it obey.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: Green spores collect in prints at both mouths. A breath line moves through the floor toward the airway wheel. The dry shell carries sound; the soft lane carries heat.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Moving carefully keeps the cloud low. Disturbing the spores cleans and stings small wounds and leaves a strong record. Muting the wheel flattens the lane’s breath for a few steps.

slip_green_spores.preview: Immediate: quieter pass. Echo: stride spacing retained by spore bed.
lines: I match my steps to the floor’s flex and keep my boots close to the ribs.
The cloud folds but does not lift. My prints set into a narrow, even lane.

disturb_green_spores.preview: Immediate: shallow sting-mend with raised attention. Echo: lifted print plume retained.
lines: I sweep my boot forward and kick the spores into a low bloom.
They sting my ankles and close two small scratches. The bloom hangs where I moved fast.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: lane breath flattens. Echo: diaphragm interest retained after repeated muting.
lines: I twist the airway wheel until the tone smooths and the floor stops pulsing under it.
Air goes flat for three breaths. The soft lane feels momentarily depthless.

turn_baffle.queued_line: Fine filaments lift near the wheel and hold their bend after the air goes flat.

possibility_tree: Move carefully: Hymn accepts stealthy exposure instead of open struggle.
Disturb the spores: Hymn accepts exposure for access through the green route.
Mute the airway wheel: Hymn changes the room mechanism and redirects future pressure.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: Bell polyps in the wall thrum with the wheel’s tone. When the breath line dips, the bells leak a thin carry of route clicks.
split_green_corridor.line_2: If I stand still, the clicks sort into short and long beats. Flattening the breath quiets the bells but wakes nearby tissue to listen.

listen_at_green_split.preview: Immediate: click pattern learned. Echo: breath map retained for later corridor sort.
lines: I count the clicks: two short, one long, then a pause.
The floor under both mouths picks up the same pattern when I shift my weight.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: bells go quiet. Echo: nearby tissue notes flat-air bias.
lines: I turn the wheel until the clicks smear into a single tone.
The bells stop. Filament hairs along the seam lean toward the quiet.

retreat.preview: Immediate: missed read with trace noise. Echo: light carry tick retained.
lines: I step back out of the leak zone.
The last clicks travel down the dry shell like grit in a pipe.

possibility_tree: Hold still and listen: Hymn studies the alternate route before choosing a body risk.

Back away from the bells: Hymn preserves the body now and leaves the room unresolved.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The fork wraps a swollen artery on the left. The right lane is a dry split of sharp plates that catch heel dust.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Opening the artery smears fresh scent. Forcing the dry lane cuts skin and costs breath. Marking the branch sets a cleaner line later.

open_red_artery.preview: Immediate: wet passage and scent smear. Echo: red corridors retain heat-scent.
lines: I pull the seam and smear heat along the wall with my forearm.
The artery yields and slicks my sleeve. The bead line keeps the print of my temperature.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: shoulder scrapes and breath cost. Echo: plate seams carry my stride.
lines: I drop weight into the plate lane and hold my ribs away from the edges.
The plates take a clean cut from my boot. The spacing reads like steps left behind.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: quieter next fork of this family.
lines: I score the inner elbow of the split and dust the cut with dry skin.
The fork takes the mark and stops shifting under my feet.

possibility_tree: Open the artery: Hymn opens the violent route and lets pursuit read the fresh wound.
Brace through the dry lane: Hymn survives by stance and pressure discipline, but leaves strain behind.
Mark the branch: Hymn leaves route memory that can guide or accuse her later.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: Pressure rises in both walls. The artery knots and sweats. Plate seams flex like a breath held too long.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Rushing costs skin and noise. Venting bleeds pressure and leaves scent. Marking the branch holds a cleaner line later.

rush_red_split.preview: Immediate: fast passage, skin cost, noise. Echo: danger rises in later red forks.
lines: I drive my shoulder between the plates before they settle.
Edges click along my jacket and count the rush in hard taps.

vent_red_split.preview: Immediate: biomass smear and pressure drop. Echo: wet scent retained by artery tissue.
lines: I open a shallow cut and press it to the knot until the wall softens.
Warm fluid runs thin. The knot slackens and keeps my scent in its beads.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: cleaner later split.
lines: I notch the seam at knee height where the flex was worst.
The movement drops. The notch holds alignment.

possibility_tree: Rush through: Hymn chooses speed over control and carries pressure forward.
Cut a vent: Hymn spends the room pressure now to change later movement.
Mark the branch: Hymn leaves route memory that can guide or accuse her later.
split_red_corridor.progression_vector: The scenario can improve Hymn's knowledge, resources, or anatomy while also adding debt, exposure, injury, or pursuit pressure.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The artery swells at shoulder height. A blood hunter shears loose wet and threads its jaws toward my heat. The bead line ahead shows where it has been sampling riders at this fork.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Fighting strips it for biomass and noise. Avoiding uses the artery’s sensor groove to turn its search down the wrong lane; the wall keeps that cue even after I pass.
split_red_corridor.beast_state_change: Hunter search heat can be misdirected or warmed by the player's choice.

combat.preview: Immediate: fight and noise. Echo: wet walls remember the kill heat.
lines: I meet it at the swell and cut it where the jaw hinge is soft.
Its blood runs back into the wall and warms the bead line.

proceed.preview: Immediate: no fight. Echo: hunter search vector retained in the wall.
lines: I slide off the artery side and keep my breath shallow.
The bead line holds the hunter’s turn toward my last heat.

combat.queued_line: The bead line keeps a warmer interval where I killed it.

proceed.queued_line: The wet wall keeps the hunter's angle after I leave.

Avoid the hunter: Hymn carries the visible pressure forward without resolving it.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The fork steadies. The artery still pulses. The dry plates stop shifting underfoot.
split_red_corridor.line_2: No clean gain here. I leave before the walls build again.

proceed.preview: Immediate: passage. Echo: fork noted by tissue.
lines: I pick the quieter elbow and move until the heat drops.
My boots stop catching on the plate teeth.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: later red forks align sooner.
lines: I touch a quick groove into the calmer wall.
It holds the angle for the next body through.

possibility_tree: Leave the split: Hymn carries the visible pressure forward without resolving it.

amar_creepstride_red_chapel.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_1: The chapel gives us three strides. Amar owns the middle one. His saw waits low, where my wrist has to pass if I want the seam.
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_2: The hunter behind me hits the corridor once. The floor rhythm stutters. Amar smiles because pressure makes students honest.

combat.preview: Immediate: close fight. Echo: the hunter hears Hymn stop running.
lines: I step inside the saw before it can bite my wrist. Too close for his full cut. Close enough for his elbow to split my cheek.
I put him into the wall on the second count. The tendon opens, but the hunter behind me hears me stop running and answer with violence.

listen_red_wall.preview: Immediate: learn the wall's opening rhythm. Follow-up: pressure test in two rooms.
lines: I keep my wrist out of his saw and set my boot where his bad foot taps. The wall answers on the third beat.
Amar does not become safer. He becomes legible. The timing stays in my wrist after the seam opens.

retreat.preview: Immediate: keep distance. Echo: Amar and hunter decide the pressure without Hymn.
lines: I give him the middle stride and drop back as the hunter strikes the corridor again.
Amar turns his saw toward the seam. For one breath he is the door. After that, his limp follows my route.

listen_red_wall.queued_line: The third beat stays in my wrist after the chapel opens. It is not a prayer. It is timing.

retreat.queued_line: Amar's limp keeps time behind the wall. The hunter keeps worse time behind him.

possibility_tree: Step inside his saw: Hymn proves close-measure violence and attracts hunter attention.
Learn when the wall opens: Hymn gains a repeatable red-corridor discipline under Amar's dangerous tutelage.
Let Amar hold the door: Hymn survives the room while letting someone else define her route pressure.
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.progression_vector: Hymn can begin learning saw timing body discipline, become recognized as a close fighter, or remain mobile at the cost of dependence and pursuit pressure.

game_opening_descent.speaker: Hymn
game_opening_descent.line_1: Chorus, I am inside. The outer membrane sealed behind me. No clean exit. The walls breathe. The slope pulls down.
game_opening_descent.line_2: Something died at the bottom. Armor cracked open, ribs exposed. Three things move in the cavity. They noticed me first.

lines: I descend toward the split armor.
The three symbiotes pause under the ribs and wait for my hand.

symbiote_host_offer.speaker: Hymn
symbiote_host_offer.line_1: Chorus, body at the foot of the slope. Armor split open. Three symbiotes are still moving under the ribs.
symbiote_host_offer.line_2: One bond is possible. The shock will kill the others and make the survivor dependent on me.

take_symbiote.preview: Immediate: one partner survives. Echo: dependency rhythm carried into later rooms.
lines: I open the ribs enough to expose the wet hinge and let one latch at the shoulder.
Two others seize and go still. The survivor waits under my skin with its own timing.

leave_symbiote.preview: Immediate: preserve body boundary. Echo: the host cavity records a solitary body.
lines: I seal the split plate and step past without touching the cage.
Heat from the floor drops on the far side of the slope. I keep my own timing and the chest stays open behind me.

take_symbiote.queued_line: The shoulder seam tightens before I ask. The symbiote has learned the shape of danger faster than I wanted.

merchant_arrival.speaker: Her
merchant_arrival.line_1: Chorus, contact. The spider-bodied merchant waits in the crossing with six hands, a scale, and a sealed egg behind him.
merchant_arrival.line_2: No reply from Chorus. His prices are already set in wet weights.

merchant_reckoning.speaker: Her
merchant_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the corridor opens into the merchant's scale room. Side paths seal behind curtains of red muscle.
merchant_reckoning.line_2: I ran from him too often. Now he wants all of me on the scale.

hunter_reckoning.speaker: Her
hunter_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the buzzing stops behind me. The blood hunter drops into the lane ahead, blocking the only open route.
hunter_reckoning.line_2: This is the bill for all that distance.

corruption_claim.speaker: Her
corruption_claim.line_1: Chorus, my hands open without asking me. The wall tissue opens with them, matching the shape of my fingers.
corruption_claim.line_2: Too much of this place fits me. I lose the boundary.

story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_1: A transit cord drops beside my wrist and holds the beat I let the lock take.
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_2: One nearby rib answers on that count. It will open quiet, but not wide.

lines: I hold breath through the long gap. The cord slackens when I release.
The next rib keeps a narrow quiet slip for that rhythm.
I break the count with my thumb and let the cord finish without me.
No favor owed. The next route stays wider and louder.

story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.speaker: Hymn
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_1: Chorus, a receipt blister opens in the wall and exposes one dry passage token.
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_2: The token carries the ration scent I paid into the valve. Its rim is sealed and clean.

story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_1: Chorus, a repair-hunter enters the corridor behind the broken rib seam.
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_2: The transit tissue still ticks where I forced it. The hunter turns whenever the vibration repeats.

story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_1: Chorus, a small ferry-larva surfaces from a service duct beside the route.
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_2: Its harness is intact at the load knots. It rises without splashing.

story_hunt_weight_record.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_weight_record.line_1: Chorus, a tendon snare drops from the ceiling at my load spacing.
story_hunt_weight_record.line_2: The torn ferry harnesses left the same interval. The loop tightens over the place my boot should land.

story_commandant_signal_mute.speaker: Hymn
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_1: Chorus, a route packet arrives with its middle command phrase missing.
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_2: The bell polyps I muted left a clean gap in the signal. The tissue beyond it opens without a confirming pulse.

story_pell_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, survey mites have copied the beetle repair into a route tag.
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_2: The ridges I left intact match the copied tag. A marked seam opens along the repair line.

story_hunt_false_wound.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_false_wound.line_1: Chorus, the repair-hunter stops at the false wound pattern and bites the wrong seam.
story_hunt_false_wound.line_2: The blood I planted holds its jaw in the shellac. The real seam stays closed behind me.

ending_soft_captain_transit.speaker: Hymn
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_1: Chorus, the lock opens before my boot reaches the pressure pad. The pulse cord starts at my wrist interval, the ferry harness lowers, and the toll valve stays shut.
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_2: No route packet names this sequence. The transit tissue runs on counts I left behind.

story_pell_survey_cuts.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_1: Chorus, a cold survey packet opens under the marrow cuts.
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_2: The cuts I obeyed align under my boots. The open floor is rougher on both sides of the lane.

lines: I keep my boots inside the old cuts.
The marrow accepts the same stride twice. The cleaner lane narrows around it.
I scuff the nearest cut and step across its clean edge.
The survey marks no longer agree about where my next foot should land.

follow_marked_plates.queued_line: The next plates lift before I step. They already know the length of my stride.

story_silt_procedure_answer.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_1: Chorus, a diagnostic answer opens in the operator wall.
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_2: The lens sequence is still running. The exposed tissue is wet enough to read and wet enough to sample.

story_pell_second_mark_warning.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_second_mark_warning.line_1: The next plates lift before I step. They already know the length of my stride.
story_pell_second_mark_warning.line_2: The marked line is cleaner than the floor around it. The teeth are ready too.

lines: I keep the pace the plates prepared.
The lane opens clean and leaves a second row of teeth upright behind me.
I drag my heel across the clean line and make the plate teeth disagree.
The next step is rougher, but the floor has to read me again.

story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.speaker: Hymn
story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.line_1: The shoulder seam tightens before I ask. The symbiote has already chosen where the next hit should land.
story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.line_2: Skin pulls toward its answer before my stance changes. It would work. That is the problem.

lines: I let it move first. The answer is fast and too eager.
It settles after the danger passes, but it keeps the shape of that decision.
I hold it under the skin until its rhythm falls behind mine.
The next movement is slower, but it is mine.

story_commandant_missing_checksum.speaker: Her
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_1: A route packet arrives without a checksum. Middle phrase is blank.
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_2: If I use it, the next split opens fast and hides one branch.

lines: I take it as-is. The blank stays blank.
Next fork hides one button.
I let it pass in the scar.
All branches stay visible next time.

story_quartermaster_teeth_count.speaker: Her
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_1: A tooth-count opens under my palm. The row shows my bites and the empty breath it wants back.
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_2: The teeth wait with their mouths open: feed them now, or lift off and leave them gapped.

lines: I press resin in until each tooth lies flat.
The row closes and rests.
I lift away. The teeth keep their gap under my heat.
The count follows in the open row.

story_lumen_wet_marker.speaker: Hymn
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_1: Chorus, the black water dries bright in my cuts.
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_2: The healed edge is readable. Wet tissue brightens when I turn toward it.

story_mother_chancel_open_tools.speaker: Hymn
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_1: Chorus, tool rests open around the bone edit I accepted.
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_2: The edit fits each socket without adjustment. The rests close before I finish moving.

story_launch_authority_reply.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_authority_reply.line_1: Chorus, a launch authorization returns with my weight attached.
story_launch_authority_reply.line_2: The first packet kept its number. This one is warm under my fingers and already contracting.

story_pell_spoiled_lane.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_1: Chorus, a cold lane breaks before it reaches my boots.
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_2: The survey field is still readable, but the lice cannot keep one path clean long enough to hold my step.

story_marrow_lice_hunger.speaker: Hymn
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_1: Chorus, marrow lice gather on the warm side of this bone seam.
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_2: They follow the warm absence left by the ration I took. The bone around it has gone cold.

story_silt_sample_edge.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_sample_edge.line_1: Chorus, another operator wall opens a pore at the exact edge of my sealed wound.
story_silt_sample_edge.line_2: The procedure tissue measures the fit against the clean rim in my skin.

story_operator_sealed_refusal.speaker: Hymn
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_1: Chorus, another cellar keeps its first two pores sealed.
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_2: The closed pores give less information and take no sample. The third pore opens blind.

story_operator_false_compatibility.speaker: Hymn
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_1: Chorus, a procedure wall opens compatibility pores for tissue I did not give it.
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_2: The false wall sample has a matching pore. Repair fluid gathers around the wrong material.

story_hunt_bright_scar.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_1: Chorus, a bright scar appears before the mites finish cleaning this junction.
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_2: The route opens fast. Its pulse already matches my stride, and the same brightness remains behind me.

story_glass_apostle_blank_route.speaker: Hymn
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_1: Chorus, this scar map has one blank route with no gait pulse.
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_2: Scar mites stop at its edge and clean around it. The blank tissue stays dull.

story_quartermaster_clean_payment.speaker: Her
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_1: A larder tongue opens one pocket without closing its teeth.
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_2: The pulse under it is even. It reads me as paid.

lines: I take what opens and close it with one finger.
Next harbor reads dry once.
I feed past even. The scale hums.
Prices ease once more. Claim cools.

story_merchant_hunger_open.speaker: Hymn
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_1: Chorus, a sealed ration pocket opens before I touch the scale.
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_2: The membrane is already pulled back. The open edge is wet where hunger should press it.

story_larder_closed_credit.speaker: Hymn
story_larder_closed_credit.line_1: Chorus, a credit grub is sealed under its membrane and does not open when I pass.
story_larder_closed_credit.line_2: The membrane stays closed over the grub. No teeth lift from the shelf.

story_harbor_paid_dock.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_1: Chorus, a dock mouth lowers two ribs before the black fluid reaches my cuts.
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_2: The payment rim is clean. The dock ribs stay dry above my wounds.

story_harbor_drained_scent.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_1: Chorus, this harbor basin is already low, and the mud carries my wet scent.
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_2: The drained passage is open. The route trace stays printed in the mud.

story_rite_clean_sequence.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_1: Chorus, a rite chamber has its drain cuts open in the order I used.
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_2: The cuts hold that sequence. A tool rest opens at hand height.

story_rite_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, platelet beetles seal a broken drain cut in this rite chamber.
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_2: The displaced cut will not carry fluid. The beetles close it from both ends.

story_launch_measured_interval.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_measured_interval.line_1: Chorus, this launch bore contracts at the interval I gave the last one.
story_launch_measured_interval.line_2: The ring measure matches my recorded pause. The tissue tightens before I step in.

story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_1: Chorus, a red shortcut opens beside the launch rings.
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_2: The wound is visible from the main route. Fluid gathers at the cut edge.

ending_pell_white_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_pell_white_route.line_1: Chorus, the white lanes have stopped branching. Each cold cut gives the same safe step.
ending_pell_white_route.line_2: The survey record is complete. My next step fits the cut before I take it.

ending_operator_component.speaker: Hymn
ending_operator_component.line_1: Chorus, the procedure cellars now open before my hands reach them.
ending_operator_component.line_2: The sampled rims match my skin. Each pore opens at hand height before I reach it.

ending_opened_hunt_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_1: Chorus, every scar route brightens before I choose.
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_2: The map lights a clean step before I move. Scar mites stop working and leave the bright path open.

ending_merchant_debt.speaker: Hymn
ending_merchant_debt.line_1: Chorus, the larder opens all ration pockets before I touch the scale.
ending_merchant_debt.line_2: The food is already counted against me. No trader-mouth opens. Every pocket breathes with the same open count.

ending_lumen_wet_claim.speaker: Hymn
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_1: Chorus, the harbor fluid rises to the height of every healed cut.
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_2: The wet organs read the healed edges and route me by the same mark.

ending_mother_chancel_tool.speaker: Hymn
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_1: Chorus, the rite chamber opens its tool rests around my body before I kneel.
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_2: Tool rests close on the shape already cut into me.

ending_commandant_launch.speaker: Hymn
ending_commandant_launch.line_1: Chorus, the launch rings contract on command before I enter the bore.
ending_commandant_launch.line_2: The command phrase repeats from every ring. No local pore opens to inspect me.

story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.line_1: A wet rasp rides my inhale. The rib cage clicks—small cartilage teeth under my sternum—then the red rows ahead warm on my chest rise and cool slow when I breathe out.
story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.line_2: Boot soles answer behind me on that same ragged count against the floor plate valve.

lines: I shorten my breath and change stride to break the count.
The echo steps lose one beat and fall back at the next turn.

buttons.label: Break the count with short steps
Hold a brace and slow the lungs

run.echo_notes: Pursuit weakens after the count breaks.
lines: I crowd the turn and make three short steps on the off-beat.
The answering footfalls miss and smear into floor scrape.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: hold and clear the echo.
brace_through_red_split.echo_notes: No further hunt echo from this trail.
lines: I brace my ribs with both arms and slow the lungs under the next surge.
The tick loses my rhythm and drops away.

story_wet_marker_dock_price.speaker: Her
story_wet_marker_dock_price.line_1: A dock mouth opens early. Air tastes like the sterile clean on my glove.
story_wet_marker_dock_price.line_2: Its bite ridge is shaped for proof, not food.

buttons.label: Hide my hand and pass wide

lines: I raise the glove. It exhales and opens one notch without taking.
Next wet reader expects this.
I keep out of its bite and pass the rim.
No proof given.

story_threads_delay_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_threads_delay_echo.line_1: In a wet stair, white threads lift toward my hand, then hesitate for one breath before they climb.
story_threads_delay_echo.line_2: Intake pores along the wall open late, as if listening for my next beat.

buttons.label: Hold my breath through the pause

proceed.preview: System takes my cadence.
lines: I keep the same rhythm. The pores follow the held beat and open on the second.
Threads part cleanly and fall behind my wrist like trained cilia.

story_refusal_trail_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_refusal_trail_echo.line_1: A wet seam breathes a sterile odor with a blank at the center, like I skipped a breath here.
story_refusal_trail_echo.line_2: Scuffs on the rim show bodies stopping short and backing away.

buttons.label: Hold the corner and let the blank pass

proceed.preview: Silence crosses my position.
lines: I wait at the turn. The odor dip slides past like cold air through a seam.
Nothing touches me, but the blank travels on with my shape inside it.

story_nursery_scent_orients.speaker: Hymn
story_nursery_scent_orients.line_1: Chorus, another brood lane meets me with sacs already turned. Their cilia lean toward my sleeves before I touch them.
story_nursery_scent_orients.line_2: Sweet air is heavier here. The shoulder gap is narrow, but one skin has softened where my scent matches the film.

proceed.preview: Immediate: guided slip recorded.
lines: I take the softened shoulder and keep my coat tight.
The leaning sacs brush instead of bursting. The lane notes the same trace.

story_resin_lane_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_resin_lane_echo.line_1: Resin beads stripe a shoulder-wide swath. The air bites like clean burn where someone cleared passage.
story_resin_lane_echo.line_2: The bead line carries me fast if I take the sting.

buttons.label: Set boots on the bead line

proceed.preview: Immediate: faster lane taken.
lines: I set my boots on the bead line and keep my mouth closed.
The sharp layer scrapes my throat. The lane stays open behind me.

story_brood_learning_thin.speaker: Hymn
story_brood_learning_thin.line_1: This brood lane feels under-counted. Sacs hold still until I pass their level.
story_brood_learning_thin.line_2: Film on the floor is smooth and unmarked. Nothing here reaches first.

buttons.label: Keep my shoulders flat and go on

proceed.preview: Immediate: quiet pass continues.
lines: I keep my weight narrow and let the film carry it.
The lane does not lift a mark I can see.

story_hatchling_guard_delay.speaker: Hymn
story_hatchling_guard_delay.line_1: A side fold ahead shows doubled sign: small drag ridges with a fresh palm smear angled alongside.
story_hatchling_guard_delay.line_2: Breath noise comes from the fold. The guard is deeper, not at the mouth.

buttons.label: Take the fold under that sign

proceed.preview: Immediate: commitment recorded.
lines: I step into the ridges and keep my palm low along the smear.
The film takes two bodies again and carries me toward breath.

story_quiet_shell_ledger.speaker: Hymn
story_quiet_shell_ledger.line_1: An opened shell hangs in shadow. Its hinge is cooled and clouded; a sealed thumb edge shows a clean close.
story_quiet_shell_ledger.line_2: Residue beads under the seal in a clear line I read by thumb pad while the hinge teeth stay cold and still.

buttons.label: Press the hinge and move on

proceed.preview: Immediate: ledger confirmed.
lines: I press the cooled hinge once and feel it hold.
The seal keeps its cloud. The room reads a small hand only.

story_trail_dried.speaker: Hymn
story_trail_dried.line_1: Old drag ridges lie dull across the film in a side branch. Wet shine has gone from the grooves.
story_trail_dried.line_2: The main lane is cleaner. I leave the branch to dry without my print.

proceed.preview: Immediate: trail left dull.
lines: I keep to the clean lane and do not touch the grooves.
The dull ridges flake under their own weight.

story_plate_lane_sets_stride.speaker: Hymn
story_plate_lane_sets_stride.line_1: Bright plates ahead sit already on my heel spacing. Each flex meets my foot without a search.
story_plate_lane_sets_stride.line_2: Dust between plates shows a single clean line. I move before they tighten.

story_hunt_blood_read.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_blood_read.line_1: Chorus, a dry warmth-smell holds in this lane. Barbs point along it like needles following heat.
story_hunt_blood_read.line_2: Red flecks on my sleeve match the stain on the ribs. Something that hunts by scent has an easy route here.

story_tracker_narrow_read.speaker: Hymn
story_tracker_narrow_read.line_1: The next dry floor keeps my prints in one tight line. Powder pools between steps instead of over them.
story_tracker_narrow_read.line_2: A thin intake seam ahead hums as if it has been sampling this width.

hunter_scent_lift.speaker: Hymn
hunter_scent_lift.line_1: The corridor ahead smells like my glove. Resin sweetness hangs under the seam and holds my wrist print.
hunter_scent_lift.line_2: A scrape at nose height matches where I brushed the wall.

red_corridor_noise_variant.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant.line_1: The next red seam repeats a dry tick in the wall and a thin patch where resin set fast.
red_corridor_noise_variant.line_2: When I brush it, film tacks to my glove and lets go. The tick keeps its interval in the bone.

red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.line_1: A bare red seam ahead keeps the same dry tick with no film. The sound walks the joint like a metronome.
red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.line_2: Stored pressure, not leak. My steps add a second, softer click until I stop.

buttons.label: Match the dry tick and move

red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.line_1: A resin plaque ahead closes on a cough. The beads under its lid never finished their line.
red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.line_2: That half-click rides the seam like a flaw in the rhythm.

ledger_repeat_echo.speaker: Hymn
ledger_repeat_echo.line_1: A toll mouth opens downstream with its beads already aligned. The pattern under the lid matches what I left.
ledger_repeat_echo.line_2: Clean payment holds a flat line. Two soft ticks linger after close.

ledger_repeat_echo_open.speaker: Hymn
ledger_repeat_echo_open.line_1: Another toll plate warms at my approach. Inside the resin, two soft ticks answer in my pace.
ledger_repeat_echo_open.line_2: I walk past and let it close on my count.

red_corridor_noise_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_echo.line_1: Two opposing red rows kiss at their tips and hum. The pitch matches the lane I left.
red_corridor_noise_echo.line_2: Two rows ahead tick together once, louder than the rest. The teeth hold a thin seam that presses my sleeve if I shoulder; the count leaves a narrow quiet slip if I keep it.

buttons.label: Keep the count and pass quiet
Shoulder a gap through the hum
Back off and let the rows settle

red_corridor_grit_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_grit_echo.line_1: Red grit clings in my tread and sits in floor cuts ahead. Chipped tips line to the lane I kicked.
red_corridor_grit_echo.line_2: Whatever I do next prints here.

buttons.label: Step back into my broken line
Kick fresh chips and widen it
Withdraw and leave the trace short

red_corridor_timing_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_timing_echo.line_1: Open beats land in the rhythm my legs kept. One window holds a breath longer.
red_corridor_timing_echo.line_2: The front teeth pause with a visible gap. Matching that pause gives me a clean shoulder pass; breaking it with a shove will scrape; standing off lets the teeth finish the close.

buttons.label: Match the long window and go
Break the count with a hard shove
Stand off and lose the rhythm

red_corridor_predator_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_predator_echo.line_1: Copper-sour air ahead. Floor rows carry a dragged scent between tips.
red_corridor_predator_echo.line_2: A lane reader hunts close. Cut forward now, slip on the open, or fall back.

buttons.label: Cut forward before it fixes me
Fall back and let the scent drift

red_corridor_offtime_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_offtime_echo.line_1: A rear row clicks off-time once, then corrects. The ambush missed a catch.
red_corridor_offtime_echo.line_2: One tooth lags and shows a thin wet notch. Moving on that notch slips me through; jamming the notch will teach the teeth harder; holding here lets the row reset tight.

buttons.label: Jam the flaw open with a shove
Hold position until the count resets

red_corridor_fast_close_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_fast_close_echo.line_1: Fresh hardening ridges sit on the next rows. They close one notch sooner than the count suggests.
red_corridor_fast_close_echo.line_2: The teeth bite early on my knee line. If I rush I catch the slim open; if I force, the ridges take shoulder skin; if I back out, the lane is lost.

buttons.label: Force a gap through the new ridges
Back out from the fast close

story_smother_flat_air_warning.speaker: Hymn
story_smother_flat_air_warning.line_1: A later corridor answers the flat-air habit. Diaphragm tissue ahead is smooth and underfilled. Filament hairs lean into the stillness like grass after a held breath.
story_smother_flat_air_warning.line_2: When I test a step, the membrane closes a narrow window, then waits for the same flat interval I set at the wheel.

buttons.label: Back away and reset my pace

proceed.preview: Immediate: timed pass. Echo: flat-air bias recorded again.
lines: I match the pause and walk through on the low of the breath.
The window closes behind my heel and keeps the same held interval.

retreat.preview: Immediate: avoided squeeze. Echo: diaphragm keeps its pause without me.
lines: I step back before the tissue takes my timing.
The membrane holds the pause like a habit looking for a body.

story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.line_1: Red wall beads ahead run warmer in one short interval. The heat band matches the jaw height I cut before.
story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.line_2: The corridor opens easier along that warm stripe. I ride it through before the pulse closes.

story_hunt_scent_tracking.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_scent_tracking.line_1: Wet tissue ahead turns toward my last heat. A hunter groove opens shallow in the wall.
story_hunt_scent_tracking.line_2: Cross quiet and give it little, or run the dry edge and trade scent for noise.

story_lathe_recognizes_touch.speaker: Hymn
story_lathe_recognizes_touch.line_1: Another ridge-cutter thins its bite when my hand shadow crosses the eye pore.
story_lathe_recognizes_touch.line_2: Fresh curls gather under the lip. It is holding my touch profile from the other lane.

story_guard_drawn_to_jag.speaker: Hymn
story_guard_drawn_to_jag.line_1: A later ridge shows a torn shave with my wedge angle in it.
story_guard_drawn_to_jag.line_2: A hanging guard has already dropped to watch that jag.

story_lathe_rhythm_recall.speaker: Hymn
story_lathe_rhythm_recall.line_1: Teeth scrape in the wall on the same shallow interval I counted before.
story_lathe_rhythm_recall.line_2: The safe step still fits between two thin cuts.

story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.line_1: The cache lane ahead smells like warm tissue and dry marrow floss.
story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.line_2: Fibers on my sleeve match the guard’s residue. Hunters read this kind of thread as a route.

story_pell_cache_note.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_cache_note.line_1: A rib screen farther on has dust settled in my boot width.
story_pell_cache_note.line_2: Whoever reads caches will know I left that one closed.

amber_sweet_record.speaker: Hymn
amber_sweet_record.line_1: A later seam carries the same sugar on the air. Wall skin is soft where a sac was eased.
amber_sweet_record.line_2: My glove print sits in the tack, neat enough for a nose to follow.

plate_snare_warning_v1.speaker: Her
plate_snare_warning_v1.line_1: Plates ahead sit on my stride already. Fine teeth show in the seams.
plate_snare_warning_v1.line_2: Break it now and they forget. Keep it and they set a mouth for me one room ahead.

lines: I step wide and grind the glow dull.
The lane loses my count.
I keep heel-to-toe. Teeth align for me downstream.
Snare scheduled.

healing_instability_probe_v1.speaker: Her
healing_instability_probe_v1.line_1: Clean rims at my cuts shine. One edge stays dry and sharp against the wet.
healing_instability_probe_v1.line_2: If I show that edge, a reader will take it. If I cover it, the drag keeps on me.

lines: I raise the rim. The reader bites once and goes still.
The trail brightens in my wake.
I keep it under skin and cloth.
The pull stays on me.

amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.line_1: Two rooms later the corridor narrows to one red seam. The wall opens on the same third beat, but faster. Amar comes out of a side duct with his saw already wet.
amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.line_2: The hunter is close enough that the seam flexes toward its breath. If I cut late, the wall keeps my arm. If I cut early, Amar gets the opening.

buttons.label: Brace and take the line alone

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: clean passage with learned timing. Echo: wall timing advances.
lines: I cut when his bad foot lands. The tendon opens under my wrist instead of against it.
Amar passes after me, not before me. That matters. I know the opening now, even if the saw is still his.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: solo breakthrough. Echo: wrist strain invites body adaptation.
lines: I set my shoulder in the seam and take the tendon on my wrist guard.
The passage opens ugly. A hot line crawls under my forearm, shaped almost like a future spur.

combat.preview: Immediate: kill Amar under pressure. Echo: the hunter learns the timing.
lines: I let him make the opening and put my blade through him as the seam starts to relax.
His saw falls on the third beat. The hunter behind us learns the timing before I clear the gap.

mark_red_branch.queued_line: My wrist remembers when the cut tendon opens. A chamber ahead breathes on the same rhythm.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The line under my forearm heats whenever red tissue contracts. Something in me wants a harder wrist.

possibility_tree: Cut on Amar's third beat: Hymn turns instruction into owned technique.
Brace and take the line alone: Hymn survives by body debt and opens mutation appetite.
Kill Amar for the opening: Hymn removes the teacher but teaches the hunter her timing.
amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.progression_vector: This beat decides whether wall timing becomes discipline, mutation hunger, or hunter-readable habit.

amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.line_1: The next chamber is a lung with ribs too close for a full swing. Warm bags swell from the wall. Each breath pulls hunter scent through the side duct.
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.line_2: Amar kneels because the floor hooks his shins on purpose. He puts the saw across two cords and waits for me to choose the count or the bite.

buttons.label: Leave Amar in the narrow space

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: learn breath timing. Follow-up: controlled escape.
lines: I keep the saw, cords, and side duct in one line until the lung shows its slow breath.
The hunter route opens only on the downbeat. I leave with its breathing rhythm under my ribs.

cut_heart_cords.preview: Immediate: shared cut misdirects pursuit. Echo: debt to Amar and saw timing both rise.
lines: We cut opposite cords on the same beat. His saw binds. My blade finishes the line before the lung can inhale.
Cold red air pours across us and takes our scent sideways. For one room the hunter follows the wrong breath.

retreat.preview: Immediate: escape by sacrifice. Echo: debt to Amar follows the route.
lines: I step out of the narrow gap and let the lung pull him into it.
The hunter bites where Amar has to be. The route opens, but the saw keeps knocking inside the wall after I pass.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The lung rhythm stays under my ribs. The next red seam breathes before it moves.

cut_heart_cords.queued_line: Cold red air follows the cord-cut. The hunter takes the false route first.

possibility_tree: Watch the lung breathe: Hymn gains route timing and keeps the fight controlled.
Cut opposite cords with Amar: Hymn accepts shared technique and pursuit misdirection.
Leave Amar in the narrow space: Hymn survives through sacrifice and deepens debt to Amar pressure.
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.progression_vector: This beat converts the wall timing from seam-reading into breath-reading under pursuit, or turns Amar into the cost of passage.

amar_creepstride_last_stride.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_last_stride.line_1: Final pinch. The seam closes too fast for Amar's limp and too narrow for my old stance. The hunter comes in low, nose first, where the wall has learned our timing.
amar_creepstride_last_stride.line_2: I set my wrist on the third beat. The tendon opens before the bite lands. Amar sees me do it without his saw and lowers his head once.
possibility_tree: Wake with the wall timing: Hymn carries a red-corridor stance into future runs.
If the chain was broken earlier, this ending pressure diverts into hunter noise, mutation appetite, or debt to Amar instead.
amar_creepstride_last_stride.progression_vector: The scenario pays out as learned martial anatomy: a route-reading wrist discipline that can later become stance, reputation, or mutation.

story_white_marrow_cold_step.speaker: Hymn
story_white_marrow_cold_step.line_1: Another marrow floor clicks under me. Lice wait inside the clean cuts, leaving pale cold edges beside warmer flats.
story_white_marrow_cold_step.line_2: My foot finds the cold edge before the lane can take a full print. The marked floor waits for the rest of my weight.

lines: I touch the cold edge first and lift before warmth settles. The lane loses the full shape of my stride.
I leave the cut floor before it finishes reading me. The trick stays partial, but so does the field's record.

story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.speaker: Hymn
story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.line_1: The next survey cuts are dirty before I reach them. Lice drag marrow dust from one lane into another.
story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.line_2: The cleanest cut is only half clean. It gives a route and asks for a fresh mark in the same motion.

lines: I cross through dust and broken marks. Nothing follows cleanly, including me.
I scrape one narrow line with the edge of my glove. It gives me a route and gives the field a fresh mark.

story_white_marrow_blood_hound.speaker: Hymn
story_white_marrow_blood_hound.line_1: A hound shape pauses at the far end of the next cold lane. It lowers its nose to an old red scrape in the white floor.
story_white_marrow_blood_hound.line_2: It has my blood direction, not my stride. Its head is still down, but the hallway is short.

lines: I move while its nose is still on the scrape. The first bite closes on old blood instead of my ankle.
I strike while its head is low. The lane gives me one clean hit and takes another red mark in payment.

operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.line_1: Two rooms later, another wall body holds low above a corridor bend. Three limbs are sunk into tool holes. The fourth hangs loose and ready.
operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.line_2: It has not seen me. When that free limb fires, its wall grip will weaken.

lines: I time the free limb's extension and move into the gap before it can reload. The organism does not get a second strike. The window was exactly where I expected it.
The cellar taught me something real. I can read grip-anchor bodies now. That changes how I move through rooms that have them.
I let it stay on the wall and move past the edge of its range. It tracks me but does not commit. I keep the knowledge and spend nothing.
The window is still there if I need it later. I do not have to use every read the moment I have it.

operator_cellar_scar_navigation.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_scar_navigation.line_1: The wall here has the same hole spacing. My hands find the pattern before I think to look for it.
operator_cellar_scar_navigation.line_2: I know which hole is third from the left without counting. The room is dark but the route is already in my body.

buttons.label: Stop and check what else is using it

lines: I move through the dark by touch. The spacing is exact. Whatever built these rooms used the same interval everywhere.
I come out the other side without having to slow down. The route is mine now.
Something else has been pressing these holes. The residue is fresh and it is not operator tissue.
There is another one in this wall. It has not finished learning the sequence yet.

operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.line_1: A low feeder in the next corridor has stopped with its snout to my blood.
operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.line_2: It is not the cellar predator. It reads the floor before it reads me.

buttons.label: Pull back and let it pass

lines: I move fast and low. It lifts its head when I pass but I am already through its angle.
It does not follow. It goes back to the floor. It is still reading.
I hold position until it moves on. It takes longer than I want.
When it goes, it goes toward the cellar. It will find the wall. It will find what I left there.
